Глоссарий

Термины, которые вводятся в каждом курсе, в порядке уроков. Нажмите выделенный термин в уроке, чтобы перейти к его описанию здесь.

Термины показаны на английском, так как перевода пока нет.

Docker для начинающих

Image

A package of a program and everything it needs to start, used as a template for containers.

Аналогия Like a recipe card that you can cook from many times without changing the card.

Container

A running copy of an image that runs separately from other containers and from the rest of your computer.

Аналогия Like one meal cooked from a recipe, which you can eat and throw away without changing the recipe.

Volume

Storage that Docker keeps outside a container, so its data survives when the container is removed.

Аналогия Like a storage locker rented separately from your house, so your things stay there when you move out.

Virtualization

A processor and computer setting that lets software run a separate virtual computer inside your computer.

Аналогия Like a room built inside a house, with its own walls and furniture but the same building.

Docker Engine

The background program that builds and runs containers on your computer.

Аналогия Like the kitchen staff of a restaurant, who work out of sight while the customers only place orders.

Terminal

A window where you type a command and read the text the computer prints back.

Аналогия Like a text chat with your computer, where you send one line and it replies underneath.

Command

One line of text that tells a program what to do, such as docker version.

Аналогия Like a written order handed to a waiter, which the kitchen then carries out.

Tag

A label after an image name, such as nginx:stable, that names a version or release line of the image.

Аналогия Like the edition label printed on a book, such as second edition, next to its title.

Exit code

The number a program returns when it stops, where 0 means it finished without an error.

Аналогия Like the stamp on a receipt, where a done stamp means it worked and any other stamp means something went wrong.

Error message

Text a program prints when it cannot finish what you asked, often naming the problem.

Аналогия Like the warning light on a car dashboard that names the part that needs attention.

Port

A numbered entrance on your computer, such as 8080, that a published container port connects to.

Аналогия Like the numbered door of an apartment building, which leads to one specific flat.

Bind mount

A folder on your computer that a container reads directly, under a path you choose inside the container.

Аналогия Like sharing a folder from your own shelf with a friend, so they read your copy rather than their own.

Named volume

A volume with a name, such as pgdata, that Docker keeps and can attach to a later container.

Аналогия Like a labelled storage box that you can hand to a new helper the next day.

Environment variable

A named setting that a program reads when it starts, such as the password for a database.

Аналогия Like a sticky note on the front door that tells every visitor one fact about the house.

Detached mode

Running a container in the background, so the terminal is free for the next command.

Аналогия Like a dishwasher that runs by itself while you do something else in the kitchen.

Working directory

The folder inside a container where its command starts.

Аналогия Like the desk where you start work each morning, with the tools you need within reach.

User-defined network

A network you create yourself, on which containers can find each other by name.

Аналогия Like a group chat where everyone can call each other by their first names.

Compose file

A YAML file, usually named compose.yaml, that describes several services and how to start them together.

Аналогия Like a seating plan for a dinner party, listing every guest and where each one sits.

Service

One container described in a Compose file, with its own name, image and settings.

Аналогия Like one position on a sports team, with its own role and its own name on the roster.

Docker socket

The connection on your computer through which programs send commands to the Docker engine.

Аналогия Like a master key that opens every room in a building for whoever holds it.

Reverse proxy

A web server that receives visits and passes each one on to the service behind it, so visitors use one address.

Аналогия Like a receptionist who takes every call and transfers it to the right person.

Prune

A Docker command that removes every unused container, network and image in one step.

Аналогия Like sweeping up every item in a shared workshop that nobody is using, including items that belong to someone else.

GitHub Desktop и GitHub

Git

Git is a version control system that records the history of changes to a folder of files, so you can return to an earlier state.

Аналогия It works like a notebook that keeps every draft of a recipe, so you can go back to the version that tasted best.

Repository

A repository is a project together with the complete record of how each of its files has changed.

Аналогия It is like a recipe binder that holds each recipe card together with every earlier draft of that card.

Commit

A commit is a saved checkpoint that records the changes to one or more files, together with a message that says what changed.

Аналогия It is like a save point in a video game, which you can load again if the next part goes wrong.

GitHub Desktop

GitHub Desktop is a free app from GitHub that lets you do Git work with buttons and menus instead of typed commands.

Аналогия It is like a car dashboard, which shows what the engine is doing in clear dials so you never have to look under the hood.

Remote repository

A remote repository is the copy of a repository that is stored on GitHub, where anyone with access can reach it over the internet.

Аналогия It is like a shared document stored in an online drive, where everyone who has been given access can open the same version.

Clone

To clone a repository means to make a complete copy of it on your computer, including its history.

Аналогия It is like photocopying a whole book, margin notes included, so that you can write in your own copy.

Local repository

A local repository is the copy of a repository on your own computer, where you make changes before you send them to GitHub.

Аналогия It is like a draft you keep on your own desk, which you can edit freely before you send the final version to the shared office.

Push

To push means to send your saved commits from your computer to the remote repository on GitHub.

Аналогия It is like posting a finished letter to the family group chat, so that the others can read it too.

Diff

A diff is a view that shows which lines of a file were added, removed or changed since the last saved version.

Аналогия It is like a teacher's red-pen marks on an essay, showing exactly which sentences were added or crossed out.

Revert

To revert a commit means to create a new commit that cancels its changes, while the original commit stays in the history.

Аналогия It is like a refund for a purchase: the refund is a new record, and the original purchase is still in your books.

Reset

To reset to a commit means to move the branch back to an older commit that has not been pushed, and bring the later changes back into your working files.

Аналогия It is like taking a book back to an earlier chapter, with the later pages in your hands so you can reread them or tear them out.

Разработка в паре с ИИ

AI coding assistant

An AI coding assistant is a program that reads your project files, makes the changes you ask for, and reports back in plain language.

Аналогия It is like a helper who can open your filing cabinet, edit the papers you point to, and tell you exactly what they changed.

usage-based billing

Usage-based billing charges you for the amount of text a model reads and writes, measured in tokens, rather than a fixed monthly fee.

Аналогия It is like a taxi meter, where you pay for the distance you actually travel instead of one flat fare.

API key

An API key is a secret string that identifies your account to a service so the service can serve your requests and bill you for them.

Аналогия It is like a hotel key card that opens your room and is tied to your bill.

brief

A brief is a short written request that tells an assistant what to build, why, and how you will know it is done.

Аналогия It is like the order form you hand a carpenter before any wood is cut, so you both picture the same table.

done checklist

A done checklist is a list of things you can check by looking or clicking, which you write before the work starts.

Аналогия It is like the list you tick through before a trip, checking the passport and tickets one by one.

local preview

A local preview is your site opened in your own browser from files on your computer, before anyone else can see it.

Аналогия It is like trying on a jacket in the mirror at home before you buy it.

checkpoint

A checkpoint is a saved state of the files and conversation that an assistant can return to later.

Аналогия It is like a bookmark in a long book that lets you flip back to a page you know was good.

commit

A commit is a saved snapshot of your project's files with a short message that describes the change.

Аналогия It is like a save point in a video game that you can load if the next level goes wrong.

diff

A diff is a view of what changed between two versions of a file, showing the lines that were added and removed.

Аналогия It is like comparing two drafts of an essay, with every new sentence marked in one colour and every deleted one struck through.

rollback

A rollback returns your files to an earlier saved state that you know worked.

Аналогия It is like tearing out the pages you wrote after the last good draft and starting again from that draft.

self-review

A self-review is an assistant's own report on whether its work matches the request, which you should treat as a second opinion.

Аналогия It is like a student marking their own exam, which is useful but does not replace the teacher's grading.

acceptance check

An acceptance check is a test you run yourself, with a fixed input and an expected output, to decide that the work is finished.

Аналогия It is like a building inspector who walks through the finished house with the plans in hand before signing it off.

permission mode

A permission mode is the setting that decides which actions an assistant may take without asking you first.

Аналогия It is like a family rule about which errands a child may run alone and which need a phone call first.

secret

A secret is any value, such as a password or an API key, that lets someone act as you or spend your money.

Аналогия It is like a spare key under the doormat, because anyone who finds it can walk in.

Ваш первый сайт

Page

One screen of content, such as a home page, that a browser shows as a single document.

Аналогия Like one sheet in a folder of printed sheets, where the whole folder stands for the website.

Browser

The program that finds a web page on the internet and draws it on your screen.

Аналогия Like a librarian who fetches a book from the shelves and opens it on your table.

File

A named piece of stored data on a computer, such as a text file, from which a website is built.

Аналогия Like a document saved in a labelled folder on your desk, so you can find it again later.

Brief

The written request that says what to build, who it is for and how you will know it is finished.

Аналогия Like the order form you give a carpenter, which says what to build and how you will check it when it is done.

HTML

HyperText Markup Language, the code that gives a web page its structure, such as headings, paragraphs and links.

Аналогия Like the skeleton of a house, which decides where the rooms and walls go.

CSS

Cascading Style Sheets, the code that styles web content so that it looks the way you want.

Аналогия Like the paint, furniture and decorations that make the same rooms feel warm or cold.

JavaScript

A programming language that adds features and behaviour to a web page, such as reacting when someone clicks a button.

Аналогия Like the electric switches in a house, which make something happen when you press them.

Link

An element that takes the reader to another page, file or address when it is activated.

Аналогия Like a road sign that points to another town.

Alt text

The text in an image element that describes the picture and that the browser can show in its place.

Аналогия Like the caption under a photo, which tells someone what the picture shows when they cannot see it.

Responsive design

A way of designing a page so that its layout adapts to the width of the screen it is shown on.

Аналогия Like a folding table that becomes bigger or smaller depending on how many people sit down.

Viewport

The area of the screen where a browser draws the page, which a meta tag can hint how to size.

Аналогия Like the window of a shop, which decides how much of the room people can see from the street.

Media query

A CSS rule that applies its styles only when a condition, such as a narrow screen, is true.

Аналогия Like a rule that says the umbrella comes out only when it is raining.

Cascade

The algorithm that decides which CSS value applies when more than one rule sets the same property.

Аналогия Like a family rule list where the most specific instruction for the situation is the one that is followed.

Опубликуйте свой сайт

URL

A URL is the text address that says where a resource such as a web page or an image can be found on the internet.

Аналогия It is like a full postal address written on one line, with the country, city, street and house number all in order.

HTTPS

HTTPS is the encrypted form of HTTP, which protects everything that passes between your browser and the server.

Аналогия It is like sending a letter in a sealed envelope that only the person it is addressed to can open.

Request

A request is the message a browser sends to a server to ask for a page or a file, and the server answers it with a response.

Аналогия It is like asking the librarian at a desk for a book and waiting while they fetch it for you.

Domain name

A domain name is a website's address on the internet, made of labels separated by dots, such as example.com.

Аналогия It is like the name on a shop front that people use to find the shop, while the street address is hidden behind it.

DNS

DNS, the Domain Name System, translates a domain name into the numeric address of the server that holds the site.

Аналогия It is like a phone book that turns a person's name into the number you need to call.

CDN

A CDN, or content delivery network, is a group of servers in many places that keep copies of the same files so that each visitor gets a nearby copy.

Аналогия It is like a chain of shops that stock the same products in every city, so you buy from the one closest to you.

Static site

A static site is a website made of files that the browser receives exactly as they are, without a program that builds each page when someone asks for it.

Аналогия It is like a printed brochure, where every copy says the same thing until someone prints a new edition.

Build

A build is the step that turns source files, such as templates and notes, into the final files a browser can read.

Аналогия It is like baking a cake from a recipe, where the recipe is your source and the cake is what you serve.

Push

To push means to send your saved commits from your computer to the copy of the repository on GitHub.

Аналогия It is like mailing a finished chapter to the publisher so that it can be printed.

Workflow

A workflow is a file of steps that GitHub Actions runs automatically when a chosen event happens in a repository.

Аналогия It is like a recipe card that a kitchen robot follows each time a new order arrives.

Run

A run is one execution of a workflow, which shows a status and a log for each job and each step.

Аналогия It is like one rehearsal of a play, with notes on every scene so you can see where it went wrong.

Log

A log is the written record of what a run or a program printed, step by step, including any error text.

Аналогия It is like the flight recorder on an aeroplane, which writes down each event in the order it happened.

Cache

A cache is a stored copy of a response that a browser or a service reuses instead of asking the server again.

Аналогия It is like a photocopy of a menu kept at your table, which can be out of date once the restaurant changes it.

Not found (404)

A 404 Not Found response means the server cannot find the file at the address that was requested.

Аналогия It is like a letter that comes back to the sender because no house with that number exists on the street.

Branch

A branch is a separate line of saved changes inside a repository, so work on one branch does not change another until you combine them.

Аналогия It is like a sheet of tracing paper laid over a drawing, where you sketch changes that stay separate until you copy them across.

Deploy

To deploy means to put finished files where the public address can serve them to visitors.

Аналогия It is like hanging a finished painting in the gallery window so that passers-by can see it.

Preview deployment

A preview deployment is a test copy of a branch's changes at its own address, which does not replace the live site.

Аналогия It is like a dress rehearsal on a separate stage before the show opens to the public.

Rollback

A rollback makes an earlier production version of a site live again.

Аналогия It is like turning back to the last page you saved in a notebook before a messy edit.

Edge node

An edge node is a server placed near visitors that answers their requests with copies of the site it has stored.

Аналогия It is like a branch library in your neighbourhood that keeps the books you borrow most often.

Access key

An access key is a credential, made of an ID and a secret, that lets a program act for a cloud account, so it must stay private.

Аналогия It is like a spare house key, because anyone who holds it can walk in, so you keep it somewhere safe.

ICP filing

An ICP filing is a registration with the Chinese authorities that a domain must complete before some acceleration regions in mainland China can serve it.

Аналогия It is like registering a shop with the city office before you open it to walk-in customers.

Certificate

An HTTPS certificate is a document issued for a domain that lets browsers confirm the site is genuine and set up an encrypted connection.

Аналогия It is like an official identity card that shows the person in front of you is who they say they are.

DNS record

A DNS record is one entry in the naming system that says where a domain name or a subdomain should point, such as an A record or a CNAME record.

Аналогия It is like one line in the phone book that says which number to call for a given name.

Ваше первое веб-приложение

State

Everything an app remembers at a given moment, and the screen shows what the state says.

Аналогия Like the scoreboard in a game, which holds the current score until the score changes.

Browser storage

A small space inside your browser where a website can keep data on your own computer, separate from other websites.

Аналогия Like a locker that the hotel gives each guest, which the guest can use but other guests cannot open.

Brief

A short written description of what an app should do, for an AI assistant or a person to follow.

Аналогия Like the note you give a carpenter before a shelf is built, saying what it holds and how big it should be.

Done checklist

A list of sentences that each start with I can, where the app is finished when every sentence is true.

Аналогия Like the list you tick off before you leave the house, checking that the keys and the wallet are in your bag.

Checkpoint

A saved version of your project, made with a commit, that you can go back to later.

Аналогия Like a save point in a video game, so you can start again from that spot if the next part goes wrong.

Backup

A second copy of your data, kept somewhere else, so you can restore it if the first copy is lost.

Аналогия Like a photocopy of an important letter, kept in a drawer in case the original is lost.

Filter

A rule that shows only the items that match what you chose, and hides the rest.

Аналогия Like a coffee filter, which holds back the grounds and lets only the coffee through.

Total

The sum of several numbers, found by adding them all together.

Аналогия Like the bill at a restaurant, which adds up the price of every dish you ordered.

Приложение с базой данных

Database

A program that stores organized data so that the data is still there after the app that uses it stops.

Аналогия Like a well-kept filing cabinet, where every folder stays in its drawer even after the office closes for the night.

Front end

The part of an app that runs in the browser and shows the page, the buttons and the forms that you use.

Аналогия Like the dining room of a restaurant, where you see the tables and the menu but not the kitchen.

Back end

The part of an app that runs on a server, receives requests, saves and reads data, and sends back a reply.

Аналогия Like the kitchen behind the counter, which prepares every order that comes in from the dining room.

Port

A numbered door on a computer that a program listens on for connections, such as 5432 for PostgreSQL.

Аналогия Like the room number of one office in a large building, so that a visitor knows exactly which door to knock on.

Table

A set of rows and columns in a database that holds one kind of thing, such as all the guestbook messages.

Аналогия Like one page of a paper ledger, with a line for each item and a box for each detail.

API

A set of addresses and rules that lets one program ask another program for data or ask it to do something.

Аналогия Like a restaurant menu, which lists what you may order without showing you the kitchen.

Brief

A short written description of what you want an app to do, which the AI reads before it writes any code.

Аналогия Like the notes a customer hands a builder before any work begins.

Env file

A plain text file named .env, with lines of the form NAME=value, that Docker Compose reads to fill in its settings.

Аналогия Like a sticky note in a drawer that lists the codes you need, kept apart from the instructions for building the house.

Column

A named part of a table that holds one kind of value in every row, and has a data type that limits what it accepts.

Аналогия Like a labelled box on a form, which accepts only the kind of answer its label asks for.

Log

A running list of messages that a program writes about what it is doing, including the errors it meets.

Аналогия Like the logbook a ship's crew writes in every hour, which shows what happened and when.

Secret

A password, key or other piece of data that gives access to something and must not be shared or stored in source code.

Аналогия Like the key to your house, which opens the door for anyone who holds it, so you keep it in your pocket and not under the doormat.

Backup

A copy of your data, kept in another place, so that you can restore it if the original is lost or damaged.

Аналогия Like a photocopy of an important letter, kept in a different drawer in case the original is lost.

Добавьте функции ИИ в своё приложение

Prompt

The text you send to a model, including your instructions and the material it should work on.

Аналогия Like the note you give a waiter that says what you want and how you want it cooked.

Model

A program trained on large amounts of text that reads the text you give it and writes an answer.

Аналогия Like a well-read friend who answers from everything they have read, and who can still get one detail wrong.

Token

The smallest unit of text a model reads and counts, which may be a word, part of a word, a character or a byte.

Аналогия Like a bead on a string, where the length you pay for depends on how many beads are on it.

Context window

The amount of text, counted in tokens, that a model can look at in one request.

Аналогия Like the desk you work at, which can hold only so many papers at once.

Hallucination

An answer that sounds confident but is factually incorrect or does not match the text it was given.

Аналогия Like a student who writes a confident essay from memory and gets a date wrong without noticing.

API

A set of rules that lets one program send a request to another program and receive a reply.

Аналогия Like an order form at a restaurant, where the kitchen acts only on requests written in the agreed form.

API key

A secret code that identifies your account to a service, so the service knows whose requests to accept and whom to bill.

Аналогия Like a library card number, which proves who you are and should be kept private.

Environment variable

A named setting that your terminal passes to the programs it starts, so they can read the value without it being written in their files.

Аналогия Like a note on the fridge that everyone in the house can read, instead of writing the phone number inside every letter.

Regression test

A check that repeats earlier test inputs after a change, to confirm that answers you accepted before are still accepted.

Аналогия Like checking that the other rooms still work after you repaint one room.

Spend limit

A maximum amount that a service lets you spend in a period, after which the service refuses further requests until you raise the limit or the period resets.

Аналогия Like a prepaid phone plan that stops calls once the credit is used up.

Spend alert

A notification that a service sends when your tracked spending reaches an amount you chose, without stopping your requests.

Аналогия Like the low-fuel warning light, which comes on before the tank is empty.

Test set

A fixed list of test inputs, each with the answer you accept, which you run again after every change.

Аналогия Like a spelling test that you give to the same class each week to see whether it is improving.

Prompt injection

Text that tries to make a model ignore its instructions and follow new instructions hidden in the content it reads.

Аналогия Like a note slipped into a stack of papers that tells you to ignore your boss and do something else instead.

Совместная работа в GitHub: ветки и pull request

Branch

A branch is a separate line of work that starts from the main version of a project, so changes on it do not reach main until you choose to merge them.

Аналогия It is like a sheet of tracing paper laid over a drawing, where you sketch changes that stay separate until you copy them onto the original.

Commit

A commit is a saved checkpoint that records the changes to one or more files, together with a message that says what changed.

Аналогия It is like dating and labelling a photo album page after you have added the pictures to it.

Push

To push means to send your saved commits and branches from your computer to GitHub.

Аналогия It is like uploading a finished photo album to a shared cloud folder so that the whole family can see it.

Pull request

A pull request is a proposal to merge the changes on one branch into another, with a place for people to review and discuss them first.

Аналогия It is like handing your homework to a teacher for marking before it counts toward your grade.

Merge

To merge means to combine the changes on one branch into another branch, usually into main.

Аналогия It is like pouring the water from one glass into a larger jug, so that the contents of both end up in one place.

Base branch

The base branch is the branch that a pull request would merge into, such as main.

Аналогия It is like the final copy of a shared essay, into which each suggested paragraph is copied once the teacher approves it.

Issue

An issue is a written note on GitHub that describes a bug, an idea or a request, and that people can discuss.

Аналогия It is like a sticky note on a community board that says what needs fixing, so anyone can add a comment under it.

Fork

A fork is your own copy of another repository on GitHub, which stays connected to the original.

Аналогия It is like copying a recipe into your own cookbook, where you can change it freely while the original book stays the same.

Open source

Open source software is software whose source code is shared so that others may read, use and change it under a license.

Аналогия It is like a community cookbook that anyone may copy and adapt, as long as they follow the rules printed on its first page.

Итоговый проект: создайте и запустите своё приложение

Scope

The list of what a project will do and what it will leave out for now.

Аналогия Like packing for a weekend trip, where you choose what fits in the bag and leave the rest at home.

Spec

A written description of what an app must do, who uses it and what it must never do.

Аналогия Like a recipe card that lists the dish to make, the ingredients to use and the steps that must never be skipped.

Done-checklist

A list of statements that are each either true or false when you test the app, and that are all true when the first version is finished.

Аналогия Like a packing list that you tick off at the door, where the trip is ready only when every line is ticked.

Branch

A separate line of work in a repository, so that changes can be made and tested without changing the main version.

Аналогия Like a draft copy of a document that you edit on the side, while the signed original stays in the drawer.

Pull request

A request to bring the changes from one branch into another branch after other people have read them.

Аналогия Like handing a finished homework page to a teacher for marking before it goes into the class folder.

Secret

A key, password or token that gives access to a service or an account, and that must never appear in a public file.

Аналогия Like the spare key under the doormat, because anyone who finds it can open the door.

Spending limit

A monthly cap on what a paid service may charge you, which stops requests or warns you when the cap is reached.

Аналогия Like a prepaid phone plan that stops calls when the credit runs out, instead of letting the bill keep growing.

Deployment

Putting a finished version of your app on a server where other people can open it at an address.

Аналогия Like moving a finished painting from the studio to the gallery wall, where visitors can see it.

README

A text file at the front of a project that tells visitors what it is, why it is useful and how to use it.

Аналогия Like the label on a jar, which tells you what is inside, what it is for and how to open it.

Portfolio

A small collection of your best finished work, shown so that other people can judge what you have made.

Аналогия Like a photo album you hand to a new neighbour so they can see what you did last summer.

Review

A check of a proposed change by another person, who leaves comments and then approves the change or asks for changes.

Аналогия Like a second reader who checks an essay for mistakes before it is handed in.

Merge conflict

A stop in merging that happens when two branches change the same part of a file, so that Git cannot choose between the two versions.

Аналогия Like two friends editing the same sentence in a shared document, so someone has to decide which words stay.

Branch protection

A rule on an important branch that controls who can change it and what must happen before a change is accepted, such as a review.

Аналогия Like a museum rule that a painting can only be moved after two staff members sign the form.

Retrospective

A short review of a finished project that records what went well, what went wrong and what to change next time.

Аналогия Like a coach who watches the match video after the game to decide what the team should practise next.

Commit history

The list of saved checkpoints in a repository, showing what changed in each one and when it was saved.

Аналогия Like the list of saved versions of a document, which shows each time someone pressed save.

Запуск готовых приложений с Docker

Self-hosting

Running a program on a computer you control, such as your own computer or a rented server, instead of using a website that someone else runs for you.

Аналогия Like cooking dinner at home instead of ordering takeout, so you choose the ingredients and you clean up afterwards.

Open source

Software whose source code is published so that people can read it, and whose license says how they may use and change it.

Аналогия Like a recipe card that anyone can read, copy and adjust, as long as they follow the terms written on the card.

Database

A program that keeps organised records, such as accounts and resumes, so that other programs can save, search and change them.

Аналогия Like a filing cabinet with labelled folders, where every record has its place and can be found again.

Port mapping

A setting that connects a port number on your computer to a port number inside a container, written as host:container.

Аналогия Like the sign at a building's front desk that sends each visitor to the right room number inside.

Health check

A regular test that a container runs to report whether its program is ready and working.

Аналогия Like a traffic light that shows whether a road is open, without moving any cars.

Secret

A private value, such as a password or a signing key, that an app needs and that must not be shared.

Аналогия Like the spare key to your house, which opens the door for anyone who holds it.

gitignore file

A file in a project folder that lists the files and folders Git should not record when you make a commit.

Аналогия Like a note on a shared fridge that tells everyone which items to leave alone.

Backup

A copy of data kept somewhere else, so that the data can be recovered after a mistake, a failure or a bad update.

Аналогия Like a spare set of house keys kept at a neighbour's, so you can still get in if you lose yours.

Migration

A script that changes the layout of a database so that a new version of an app can read and write it.

Аналогия Like moving the papers in a filing cabinet into new folders when the office adopts a new labelling system.

License

The legal terms that say what you may do with a piece of software, such as use, copy or change it.

Аналогия Like the rules on a library card that say what you may borrow and for how long.

Log

A written record of the events a program or container reports while it runs, usually with the time and a message.

Аналогия Like a ship's logbook, where each entry notes what happened and when.

Port conflict

A situation in which two programs try to use the same port number on one computer, so that one of them cannot start.

Аналогия Like two people trying to sit in the same chair, so one of them has to find another seat.

То же приложение на другом языке

Programming language

A set of written rules, with its own words and grammar, that tells a computer what to do.

Аналогия Like a recipe written in a shared cooking language, which any cook who knows that language can follow.

Runtime

The software a program needs while it runs, such as the interpreter that reads and carries out its code.

Аналогия Like the stage, lights and crew that a play needs on the night it is performed.

Dependency

A ready-made piece of code, written by someone else, that your program uses instead of writing that part itself.

Аналогия Like buying a ready-made sauce for a dish instead of making it from scratch.

Brief

A written description of the job you want done, the rules the AI must follow and how you will check the result.

Аналогия Like the order ticket a waiter gives the kitchen, which says what the table wants and what must not be changed.

Virtual environment

A folder of its own inside a project that holds the packages for that project, separate from packages used elsewhere on your computer.

Аналогия Like a separate toolbox for each job, so that one job's tools do not get mixed up with another's.

Framework

A ready-made set of tools and rules for building a certain kind of program, such as a web app.

Аналогия Like a flat-pack furniture kit, where the parts and instructions are already designed so you do not cut the wood yourself.

Regression

A problem where something that worked before stops working after a change.

Аналогия Like repainting one wall of a room and finding that the light switch on another wall no longer works.

Test case

One fixed input together with the result you expect from it, used to compare two versions fairly.

Аналогия Like tasting two batches of soup made from the same recipe and the same amount of salt, so that the difference is easy to judge.

Traceback

The list of files and lines a Python program was running when it failed, printed with the error at the end.

Аналогия Like the trail of footprints left in the snow that shows the route someone took before they fell.
